subject.title: feat: show Codex transcripts in the sidebar

question: Should OpenClaw ship cross-computer Codex transcript browsing now while `thread/turns/list` is experimental and paired nodes require approval for a new command?
rationale: The implementation is technically bounded, but accepting the upstream experimental contract and its pairing-upgrade burden is a maintainer-owned compatibility decision.

options.title: Ship after conflict and proof gates
options.body: Accept the experimental contract after resolving main conflicts, regenerating localization output, and adding real browser plus pairing-upgrade proof.

options.title: Wait for a stable Codex contract
options.body: Keep catalog-only supervision until the transcript pagination API or a supported minimum Codex version becomes stable.

options.title: Narrow to local transcripts
options.body: Ship Gateway-local transcript reads first and defer the new paired-node command and pairing upgrade.

recommendation.title: Ship after conflict and proof gates
recommendation.body: Accept the experimental contract after resolving main conflicts, regenerating localization output, and adding real browser plus pairing-upgrade proof.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced the current Codex supervision product surface and has the strongest history across its plugin, UI, and macOS boundaries.
